[![CRAN version](https://img.shields.io/cran/v/sudachir.svg)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=sudachir) [![Development version on r-universe](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Furibo.r-universe.dev%2Fapi%2Fpackages%2Fsudachir&query=%24.Version&label=r-universe)](https://uribo.r-universe.dev/sudachir)

Brings the Sudachi Japanese morphological analyzer to R, mirroring its Python interface; co-developed with Akiru Kato. On [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=sudachir); documentation at [uribo.github.io/sudachir](https://uribo.github.io/sudachir/); source on [GitHub](https://github.com/uribo/sudachir).
